purpose: Bounded architecture design references only; no canonical scientific source registration

sources.title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
sources.authorsOrOrganization: W3C; editors Luc Moreau and Paolo Missier
sources.designClaim: Explicit provenance of versions, used/generated entities and collections is useful bookkeeping; membership and broad PROV derivation do not establish PSYWERX causality.
sources.notAdopted: No wholesale PROV ontology import or empirical inference from provenance reachability

sources.title: RFC 6902: JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Patch
sources.authorsOrOrganization: Paul C. Bryan and Mark Nottingham; IETF
sources.designClaim: Ordered operations, precondition tests and failure handling motivate explicit transaction discipline.
sources.notAdopted: No unrestricted patch path into production; no claim of RFC-conformant implementation or scientific effect meaning

sources.title: NetworkX density documentation
sources.designClaim: Density depends on node/edge counts and directedness; graph class assumptions matter.
sources.notAdopted: No multigraph/self-loop behavior; no new dependency installation; no empirical interpretation

sources.title: NetworkX clustering documentation
sources.designClaim: The selected unweighted local coefficient needs explicit neighbor/triangle and low-degree conventions; weighted/directed alternatives cannot be silently interchanged.
sources.notAdopted: No weighted or directed clustering implementation; no inference about conditional closure rate

sources.title: igraph C reference manual: Structural properties, centralization
sources.designClaim: Centralization uses the vector of node-level scores and a metric/graph-specific maximum; different centrality definitions do not share an interchangeable benchmark.
sources.notAdopted: No production metric definitions or generic centrality formula approved; no igraph dependency installed

sources.title: De-anonymizing Social Networks
sources.venue: 2009 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy
sources.designClaim: Removing direct identifiers does not guarantee anonymity of relational graph data; topology can support re-identification using auxiliary information.
sources.notAdopted: No re-identification algorithm, personal-data experiment or generalized numerical risk estimate implemented

limitations: GraphML primer could not be opened through the research tool; no design claim relies on that unavailable page.

No full-paper literature review was conducted for this architecture checkpoint. Existing pilot evidence was reused; only narrow source identity verification and maintainer/standards sections were accessed.
Documentation access is not an empirical scientific study or new governed evidence.
